title: Line sketch: Swirling Hair in Motion
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: A stylized female portrait features a woman with voluminous, spiraling hair in bold and against a solid background. Her large eyes, lips, and ribbed top are centered in the composition, with flowing lines creating dynamic movement throughout the hair and shoulders. The artwork uses flat color fields, thick black outlines, and repetitive swirling patterns for a graphic effect (derived from painting #117).
